subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should docs.openclaw.ai track latest stable releases by default, stay latest-main with explicit availability markers, or rely on bundled version-matched docs while keeping public docs as latest?
rationale: The source mismatch is proven, but the durable fix changes documentation publishing and user recovery policy rather than one local code path.

options.title: Adopt version-aware public docs
options.body: Publish or label public docs so config keys cannot appear as generally available before a release accepts them.

options.title: Keep latest-main with recovery
options.body: Leave live docs on main but add prominent availability markers plus version-aware validation or Doctor recovery for unsupported documented keys.

options.title: Defer to bundled docs track
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71301 as the release-specific guidance path while accepting that public docs remain latest-main.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-aware public docs
recommendation.body: Publish or label public docs so config keys cannot appear as generally available before a release accepts them.

likelyOwner.reason: He is connected to both the current utilityModel example and the docs publish workflow decisions.
